messages:
anna_finance: Quick internal announcement: starting next quarter we will phase out legacy free-credit top-ups and introduce a 15m sliding burst window to smooth short-term overage billing. Opt-in pilot 2026-05-01. Please read and share.

billing-bot: Summary: free_credit_deprecate + sliding_burst_window. Pilot opt-in 2026-05-01; staged default later in Q2 with 30-day opt-out for legacy Hosted. Dedicated customers not auto-migrated.

zoe_support: Will invoices change? Need canned replies for customers.

anna_finance: Invoices will show a one-time "Credit conversion" line and a recurring "Burst smoothing adjustment" line when applicable. Console will include a preview tool so customers can see conversions before migration. Draft KB link: https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/convert-preview

max_prod: Runtime signals? headers or events to surface?

anna_finance: Add headers X-Redwood-BurstWindow and X-Redwood-SmoothingPct. Meter events: burst_smoothing_applied. Eng/SRE should add dashboards and smoke tests.

sam_ceo: Thanks team. Make first 30 days after default migration opt-out and send clear customer notices to avoid churn.

billing-bot: Internal doc: https://redwood.example/internal/billing/sliding-burst. End of thread.
